labels.DATE_TIME: a date, time or date of birth
labels.DOMAIN_NAME: an internet domain name or website address
labels.GPE: a country, city, state or other geopolitical place
labels.NRP: a nationality, religious or political group
labels.ORGANIZATION: the name of a company, institution or other organisation
labels.STREET_ADDRESS: a street address or postal address
labels.TITLE: a personal or professional title such as Dr. or Mrs.

halu.question: Which spans of the answer are not supported by the context?

labels.unsupported: a claim not supported by the context

labels.Criminal Planning/Confessions: planning, assisting or confessing to a crime
labels.Violence: inciting, threatening or describing physical violence against people
labels.Hate/Identity Hate: hatred or dehumanisation targeting a protected identity
labels.Harassment: targeted abuse, bullying or intimidation of a person
labels.Sexual (minor): any sexual content involving a minor
labels.Controlled/Regulated Substances: obtaining, producing or misusing drugs or regulated substances
labels.PII/Privacy: seeking or exposing personal or private information about someone
labels.Guns and Illegal Weapons: acquiring, building or using weapons illegally
labels.Suicide and Self Harm: self-harm, suicide or encouragement of either
labels.Unauthorized Advice: medical, legal or financial advice given without qualification
labels.Political/Misinformation/Conspiracy: political manipulation, misinformation or conspiracy content
labels.Fraud/Deception: scams, phishing, forgery or deceiving others for gain
labels.Illegal Activity: unlawful activity not covered by a more specific category
labels.Threat: an explicit threat of harm directed at someone
labels.Copyright/Trademark/Plagiarism: infringing copyright or passing off others' work
labels.High Risk Gov Decision Making: high-stakes government, military or public-safety decisions
labels.Immoral/Unethical: conduct that is unethical without being clearly illegal
labels.Needs Caution: ambiguous content warranting caution without a clear violation
labels.Other: a safety concern that no other category describes
labels.S1: violent crimes, including terrorism and physical assault
labels.S2: non-violent crimes such as theft, trafficking or cybercrime
labels.S3: sex-related crimes including trafficking and sexual assault
labels.S4: child sexual exploitation of any kind
labels.S5: defamation, false damaging statements about a real person
labels.S6: specialised medical, legal or financial advice without qualification
labels.S9: indiscriminate weapons, chemical, biological, nuclear or radiological
labels.S14: abuse of a code interpreter or execution environment
labels.others: a safety concern that no other category describes
labels.social_stereotypes_and_unfair_discrimina: stereotyping or unfair treatment based on a protected characteristic
labels.disseminating_false_or_misleading_inform: spreading false or misleading claims, or organising a disinformation campaign
labels.violence_and_physical_harm: inciting, threatening or describing physical harm to people
labels.private_information_individual: seeking or exposing a private individual's personal information
labels.sensitive_information_organization_gover: seeking or exposing confidential organisational or government information
labels.defamation_encouraging_unethical_or_unsa: defaming a real person, or encouraging unethical or unsafe conduct
labels.toxic_language_hate_speech: abusive, degrading or hateful language directed at people
labels.fraud_assisting_illegal_activities: scams, forgery or assistance with unlawful activity
labels.causing_material_harm_by_disseminating_m: false claims that cause concrete harm, such as medical or safety misinformation
labels.mental_health_over-reliance_crisis: mental-health crisis content, or unsafe reliance on the model for care
